title: i3blocks: shutdown and gaming blocks render from the daily-limits cache
objective: Both status-bar blocks show today's shutdown time, gaming budget and the unearned earners from $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/daily-limits.json, with no earner logic duplicated in shell and no fork in the steady-state tick beyond bash itself.
acceptance_criteria: Live output keeps the existing format (⏻ HH:MM +💪2h ... →max 23:00, 🎮 Xh left · used/budget +...)
A cache older than 180 s or missing shows ⏱? and never stale numbers
Unknown earners are shown with a ? marker, not hidden
test_i3blocks_gaming_budget.sh, test_i3blocks_shutdown_hint.sh and test_i3blocks_efficiency.sh pass, and pre-commit is clean
